newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end down on rupiah,poor H1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end down on rupiah,poor H1 earnings.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended sharply lower on Thursday due to worries over the volatile rupiah and the likelihood of expected poor first half results from some big-capitalised firms, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index ended 6.14 points, or 0.86 percent, lower at 712.05 points after touching a day low of 709.82 points.
Decliners led advancers by 85 to 39 with 65 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 496 billion rupiah against 636 billion rupiah on Wednesday.
